nodes.name: Bayesian Bandits and Acquisition Functions
nodes.description: Pure posterior-update, sampling, acquisition, and arm-selection kernels for bandits and Bayesian optimization

nodes.name: initialize_beta_beliefs
nodes.description: Creates identical positive Beta prior parameters for each arm
nodes.type_signature: (n_arms: int, prior_alpha: float = 1.0, prior_beta: float = 1.0) -> tuple[NDArray[np.float64], NDArray[np.float64]]

common_patterns.description: Initialize priors, compute UCB scores, select arm, update beliefs
common_patterns.when: Stage describes multi-armed bandit or Bayesian exploration

nodes.complexity_reasoning: Creating and initializing two vectors of size K for alpha and beta beliefs requires linear time and space in terms of the number of arms.

nodes.name: beta_bernoulli_update
nodes.description: Applies the scalar Beta-Bernoulli posterior update after one binary reward
nodes.type_signature: (alpha: float, beta: float, reward: int) -> tuple[float, float]

common_patterns.description: Initialize priors, compute UCB scores, select arm, update beliefs
common_patterns.when: Stage describes multi-armed bandit or Bayesian exploration

nodes.complexity_reasoning: The single-arm Beta-Bernoulli belief update performs constant-time scalar additions with O(1) auxiliary space.

nodes.name: thompson_sample_beta
nodes.description: Draws one explicit-RNG Thompson sample from each Beta posterior
nodes.type_signature: (alphas: NDArray[np.float64], betas: NDArray[np.float64], rng: np.random.Generator) -> NDArray[np.float64]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Drawing one Thompson sample for each of the K arms performs K independent Beta distribution draws in O(K) time and space.

nodes.name: ucb_scores
nodes.description: Computes UCB1 scores and assigns infinity to arms with no pulls
nodes.type_signature: (means: NDArray[np.float64], counts: NDArray[np.int64], total_count: int, c: float = 2.0**0.5) -> NDArray[np.float64]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Computing the UCB1 scores for K arms requires element-wise vector operations of size K in O(K) time and space.

nodes.name: bayesian_ucb
nodes.description: Computes Bayes-UCB scores as Beta posterior quantiles
nodes.type_signature: (alphas: NDArray[np.float64], betas: NDArray[np.float64], quantile: float) -> NDArray[np.float64]

common_patterns.description: Initialize priors, compute UCB scores, select arm, update beliefs
common_patterns.when: Stage describes multi-armed bandit or Bayesian exploration

nodes.complexity_reasoning: Evaluating the Beta quantile function for each of the K arms takes O(K) time and space.

nodes.name: probability_of_improvement
nodes.description: Computes Gaussian probability of exceeding the incumbent by a margin
nodes.type_signature: (mean: NDArray[np.float64], std: NDArray[np.float64], best_observed: float, xi: float = 0.0) -> NDArray[np.float64]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Evaluating the Gaussian probability of improvement for K candidate points requires element-wise normal CDF evaluations in O(K) time and space.

nodes.name: expected_improvement
nodes.description: Computes Gaussian expected improvement over the incumbent by a margin
nodes.type_signature: (mean: NDArray[np.float64], std: NDArray[np.float64], best_observed: float, xi: float = 0.0) -> NDArray[np.float64]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Computing the Gaussian expected improvement for K candidate points requires element-wise normal CDF and PDF evaluations in O(K) time and space.

nodes.name: select_best_arm
nodes.description: Selects the first arm with the largest acquisition score

common_patterns.description: Initialize priors, compute UCB scores, select arm, update beliefs
common_patterns.when: Stage describes multi-armed bandit or Bayesian exploration

nodes.complexity_reasoning: Selecting the best arm requires a linear scan (argmax) over the K acquisition scores in O(K) time and O(1) auxiliary space.

nodes.name: epsilon_greedy_select
nodes.description: Selects the best arm unless an explicit random draw triggers exploration
nodes.type_signature: (values: NDArray[np.float64], epsilon: float, rng: np.random.Generator) -> int
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Epsilon-greedy selection requires finding the argmax or selecting a random index over K arms, taking O(K) time and O(1) auxiliary space.

nodes.name: update_arm_statistics
nodes.description: Updates one arm count and running mean without retaining reward history
nodes.type_signature: (means: NDArray[np.float64], counts: NDArray[np.int64], arm: int, reward: float) -> tuple[NDArray[np.float64], NDArray[np.int64]]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Updating arm statistics copies arrays of size K and updates the selected arm's running mean and count in O(K) time and space.
